system.description: You married someone beneath your station — a countess wed to a knight, a duke wed to a baron's daughter. Among your own social class you are treated with disrespect or actively snubbed, while your spouse is ignored or treated rudely, and neither side's peers know how to behave toward the mismatched pair. Difficulty is increased by two on Social rolls dealing with your peers. Your marriage may be a happy one, but you have paid a terrible social price for it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
